module: Node "SubString" (simple). Extracts a substring with string.sub(value, data.from, data.to). Default values from = 0 and to = -1. Pins: value (in), value (out).
notes: Lua indices start at 1; from = 0 is treated as 1 by string.sub.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
